Nayara Energy Aligns Fuel Prices with Public Sector Undertakings

Nayara Energy has reduced its petrol and diesel prices in Madhya Pradesh to match those of public sector undertakings (PSUs). This move sees a reduction of 5 rupees per litre for petrol and 3 rupees per litre for diesel. The price alignment aims to bring Nayara's rates in line with government-owned fuel retailers.
